name: File Dropzone
hint: Drag a file anywhere into the window, or click to browse.
description: Drop or browse for files with per-file progress rings, type and size checks, thumbnails, retry, replace and remove. The file list is the caller's (value / onChange), uploads go through the caller's upload function. The zone wakes as soon as a file enters the window, then commits harder when it's over the zone.
usage: Use for attachments, imports, logos and avatars. Pass `upload(file, onProgress, { signal, item })` returning a promise: call onProgress(0..1) as bytes go, resolve with whatever you need later (a URL, an id; it lands on the item as `result`), reject with an Error whose message is shown on the row (the row then offers Retry). `signal` aborts when the person removes the file or it is replaced. Without `upload` nothing is sent: files are added as 'Added' and reach a <form> through `name`. Own the list with `value` + `onChange(items, detail)`; each item is { id, file, name, size, type, status: 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error', progress 0..1, error, reason: 'type' | 'size' | 'count' | 'upload', result, preview }. onChange fires on every change (add, progress, done, error, retry, remove, reset); set the list to [] to clear it, or to your own items (e.g. a stored logo with `preview` and no `file`). `multiple={false}` is single-file mode: a new file replaces the old one (a rejected one leaves the good file in place); add `hideZoneWhenFull` and the row itself offers Replace and Remove. The ref is the zone element (role=button): ref.current.focus() focuses it, ref.current.scrollIntoView() reaches it, ref.current.click() opens the file picker (call it from a click handler). `height` is the zone's height; under 150px the zone tightens its padding and icon so the text fits, and it grows only when the hint wraps onto extra lines on a narrow screen. The component is at most `maxWidth` (440px) wide; `fullWidth` or maxWidth={0} lets it fill its container. The hint prints `accept` like this: '.png' -> PNG, 'image/*' -> Images (video/* Videos, audio/* Audio, text/* Text), 'image/png' -> PNG (the subtype upper-cased, without x- or +xml), repeats dropped, joined with commas; replace it with messages.types or the whole line with messages.hint. Keep `accept` and `maxSizeMB` in sync with the server.

dataProps.description: Visible label above the zone; it names the zone for screen readers. Blank shows none (then pass aria-label).
Comma-separated extensions and MIME types the picker offers and the zone checks ('.png,.jpg', 'image/*', 'application/pdf'). Blank allows any file. Printed in the hint as described in usage.
Largest file in MB; bigger files become an error row ('Too large · max N MB'). 0 means no limit.
Several files at once. false is single-file mode: the copy says 'a file', and a new file replaces the old one.
Most files the list keeps (error rows don't count). Extra files become an error row 'Up to N files'. 0 means no limit. Ignored when multiple is false.
Height of the zone in px. Under 150 the zone uses tighter padding and a smaller icon so its text fits; it grows only if the hint wraps onto more lines on a narrow screen.
Widest the component grows, in px. 0 lets it fill its container.
Fill the container (same as maxWidth={0}).

Hide the zone while the list is full (single-file mode: one file; otherwise maxFiles). In single-file mode the row then shows Replace (opens the picker) and Remove. Dragging a file into the window shows the zone again.

The file list, controlled. Items: { id, file?, name, size?, type?, status: 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error', progress?: 0..1, error?, reason?: 'type' | 'size' | 'count' | 'upload', result?, preview? (image URL for the thumbnail) }. Pass [] to clear; pass your own items to show files that already exist.
Starting list when uncontrolled. A form reset returns to it.
Fires on every change with the whole next list. detail = { type: 'add' | 'progress' | 'done' | 'error' | 'retry' | 'remove' | 'reset', item? , items? }.
Files that passed the checks were added: the File objects and their new items.
The person removed a row (its upload is aborted first).
The person pressed Retry on a failed upload; the upload runs again on the same row.

Uploads one file. Call onProgress(0..1); resolve with anything you need later (stored on the item as `result`, the row says 'Uploaded'); reject with an Error and its message shows on the row with a Retry button. `signal` aborts when the row is removed or replaced. Without it nothing is uploaded and rows say 'Added'.

Copy overrides, each optional: title, touchTitle, awakeTitle ('Drop it here'), overTitle ('Drop to upload'), hint (the whole line under the title; null hides it), types (just the file-type part), typeError, sizeError (string or (maxMB) => string), countError (string or (maxFiles) => string), uploadError, uploaded ('Uploaded'), added ('Added'), retry, replace, remove (aria prefix, 'Remove'), list (the list's label, 'Files'). Defaults follow `multiple` ('Drop files here or browse' / 'Drop a file here or browse').
Form field name. A hidden file input carries the accepted files into the surrounding <form> (FormData gets them); a form reset empties the list.
id of the zone element (for a <label htmlFor> or a link).
An error the caller already has (e.g. 'Add a receipt to continue'), shown under the zone and announced with it.
Inert: the zone can't be focused or opened, drops are ignored, row buttons are disabled.

The zone element (role=button). ref.current.focus() focuses it, ref.current.scrollIntoView() reaches it, ref.current.click() opens the file picker (from inside a user gesture). While hideZoneWhenFull hides it, click() still opens the picker.
Shows two sample files, one still uploading (simulated). For the gallery; leave off in real use.
Old name for demo, still honoured. Leave unset.
